request: Build a service quote pipeline: each quote has a title, a customer and a quoted amount, and moves Draft, Sent, then Accepted or Declined. A quote can also be declined while it is still a draft.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Service quote" with 3 fields:
  - State (one of "Draft", "Sent", "Accepted", "Declined", required)
  - Title (text, required)
  - Quoted amount (whole number)
  It gets its own menu entry "Service quote" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Service quote records.
New optional link "Customer" from Service quote to Party. Choose it when creating a record.
New lifecycle for Service quote. Records start at "Draft".
  - Send quote changes "Draft" to "Sent" after confirmation.
  - Accept quote changes "Sent" to "Accepted" after confirmation.
  - Decline sent quote changes "Sent" to "Declined" after confirmation.
  - Decline draft quote changes "Draft" to "Declined" after confirmation.

Stored data: a new table, 2 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
